proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the compatible family of morphisms on basis opens of Y amounts to a morphism between the restrictions of G and f_*F to the basis B; by the restrict-basis-equivalence-structures lemma this is the same as a morphism G -> f_*F, which by the f-map lemma is the same as an f-map, recovering the given values on B (source lines 4492-4503)
